page.overview:
What is Kurusu?

Kurusu (written: 来栖) is a Japanese surname. Notable people with the surname include:

Atsuko Kurusu (来栖 あつこ; born 1978), Japanese actress

Ryō Kurusu (来栖 良; 1919–1945), Imperial Japanese Army officer

Saburō Kurusu (来栖 三郎; 1886–1954), Japanese diplomat
